title: 创立年份与人事清单
issue: 1991 年创办与人事获多方印证：FreeBSD 项目转发的 BSDi 新闻稿称“Leading BSD developers founded Berkeley Software Design, Inc. in 1991 to commercialize BSD technologies”；1993 年联邦法院裁定书记“the CSRG programmers, at least those who founded BSDI (Karels, McKusick, and Bostic)”；Salus 访谈转录中 Karels 自述“the founders were Rick Adams, Keith Bostic, Kirk McKusick, me, Bill Jolitz and Donn Seeley”、Adams 自述“It was my idea and my funding”。

title: 前 CSRG 成员的构成
issue: 名单可证而“整体转出”不成立：Salus 访谈转录明言“While several Berkeley developers were involved in the formation of BSDI in 1990-91, none left the University of California to join Berkeley Software Design, Inc. at the outset”，Karels 自述“I started February 1, 1992”、Bostic 称“I stayed at UC Berkeley for quite some time after BSDI was founded”——系 Adams 主创、前 CSRG 成员先后加入（1991–1992），非学术团体整体转出。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: 前 CSRG 成员的先后加入

title: Net/2 的承接关系
issue: 裁定书认定“BSDI, which is not licensed by AT&T to use UNIX, used Net2 to create its sole product, the operating system BSD/386”；McKusick 记 Jolitz 自写六文件补齐 Net/2 发布免费系统 386/BSD，BSDi 亦“started by adding the six missing files that Bill Jolitz had written”——两个 386 移植同以 Net/2 为基、一免费一专有出售获一手与当事人一致印证。

title: 许可与商标的分置
issue: USPTO 档案（经 Trademarkia 披露）：“BSD”注册商标 Reg. No. 1798509，1991-02-27 申请、首次商业使用 1991-12-10、1993-10-12 注册，档案最后持有人 Wind River Systems（BSDi 软件资产受让方），2016 年因 Section 8 未续展注销——BSD 之名为注册商标、归公司（及其受让人）所有，与代码的伯克利式自由许可分置两处。

title: 商业发行的起始时点
issue: McKusick 一手记“BSDI began selling their system including both source and binaries in January 1992 for $995”；其销售前提是校方批准的 Net/2 自由发行（裁定书引 BSDi 促销材料所本：Net2“may be freely redistributed. It is available to anyone and requires no previous license, either from AT&T or The Regents of the University of California”）——1992 年 1 月起售、起点晚于成立获证。

title: 公司来源的两说并置
issue: 官方谱系并记同源：McKusick 记 386/BSD 与 BSDi 产品皆“adding the six missing files”于 Net/2；NetBSD 官方史页称其根“from the original UCB 4.3BSD via the Net/2 release and 386BSD”且官方谱系图并列 386BSD 与 BSD/386 两支——同一来源的两说并置获官方文档互证。

title: 源代码与二进制的打包
issue: McKusick 原文“BSDI began selling their system including both source and binaries in January 1992 for $995”——源码与二进制同售、定价 995 美元获当事人一手。

title: 定价与 System V 的比价
issue: 广告口径为“touting their 99% discount over the price charged for System V source plus binary systems”（McKusick），即实付约为 System V 源码加二进制价的百分之一；FreeBSD 社区史同记“This was a 99% discount on the price AT&T charged for their System V Unix”。题面“百分之一折扣”按字面为仅减价 1%，与一手方向相反，宜改作九九折让表述。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: 定价与 System V 的九九折让比价

title: 电话营销的命名争议
issue: 1992-04-20 诉状指 BSDI“has included the ‘ITS-UNIX’ telephone number in its advertising”且该使用“likely to cause confusion… in that BSD/386 is not a ‘UNIX’ product”；裁定书程序栏记“On April 29, the parties agreed to a court-ordered stipulation that BSDI would cease using the phone number ‘1-800-ITS-UNIX’”；McKusick 记 USL 来函称其为“deceptive phone number”——误导指控与争议成立。

title: 目标客户的行业定位
issue: Wind River 2001-04-04 公告：“Market segments using BSD include Internet infrastructure, telecommunications and data communications infrastructure, and other such network-centric commercial systems”；FreeBSD 项目 2000-03-09 新闻稿转 BSDi 自述“nine out of 10 Internet Service Providers (ISPs) and Network Service Providers (NSPs) as well as 15 percent of all Internet sites run BSD systems”——ISP 与电信定位获两份一手文本。

title: 高定价低销量的模型
issue: 价格对照有一手：BSDi 995 美元源码加二进制（McKusick）对社区“low cost CD-ROM”发行（McKusick）与 Walnut Creek“publishing affordable CDROMs”（其自述）；销量侧系定性对照（FreeBSD Mall 记高峰日逾 800 套完整下载），BSDi 自身销量无量化一手，正文不宜给出具体销量数字。

title: 诉因的构成与边界
issue: 裁定书归纳争点“whether Defendants BSDI and Regents appropriated parts of Plaintiff's allegedly proprietary program ‘UNIX’… in violation of Plaintiff's copyrights and trade secrets”（修正状共十一项诉因含版权、商标与州法请求）；须注明时序：1992-04-20 初始诉状仅涉商标与虚假广告（1-800-ITS-UNIX），代码与商业秘密主张经 1992-07-24 修正状并入——“两项”概括可成立但应带时序注。

title: 禁令请求的审理过程
issue: McKusick 记“In December 1992, Dickinson R. Debevoise, a United States District Judge in New Jersey, heard the arguments for the injunction… he decided to take it under advisement”；裁定书（D.N.J. Civ. No. 92-1667）程序栏载初步禁令动议“was adjourned and consolidated with the present motions”——1992 年 12 月开庭、未当庭裁定交付评议获两源印证。

title: 六文件主张的抗辩要点
issue: McKusick 记抗辩“they were simply using the sources being freely distributed by the University of California plus six additional files”，法官限 USL 重述否则驳回；FreeBSD 社区史同记“The judge agreed and told USL ‘restate their complaint based solely on the six files or he would dismiss it’”——争点收窄到六个文件获两源印证。

title: 反诉的诉因与管辖
issue: McKusick 记 UC 抢先在加州州法院立案反诉：“The University's suit claimed that USL had failed in their obligation to provide due credit to the University for the use of BSD code in System V as required by the license that they had signed with the University”——诉因落在致谢声明义务且加州管辖先行获当事人一手。

title: 和解时点与条款的确认
issue: 驳回、和解与产品转向可并置确认：裁定书（档名 930303，D.N.J.）驳回初步禁令并限缩诉因；McKusick 记“a settlement was finally reached in January 1994. The result was that three files were removed from the 18,000 that made up Networking Release 2”，BSDi 随后转以 4.4BSD-Lite 为基——同一线索的时点与条款并置成立。

title: 清理对象的量化记载
issue: McKusick 原文“three files were removed from the 18,000 that made up Networking Release 2, and a number of minor changes were made to other files”——一万八千分之三与微改若干获当事人一手；二手时间线存在“5 files”异说（Levine《UNIX History》），正文宜以当事人口径为准并可在注中存异。

title: 版权标注的补加对象
issue: McKusick 原文“In addition, the University agreed to add USL copyrights to about 70 files, although those files continued to be freely redistributed”——约七十个文件补注获当事人一手。

title: 再发行条件的重申
issue: McKusick 原文“although those files continued to be freely redistributed”——补注后仍自由再发行、清理与开放并行获一手印证。

title: 商业发行的中断代价
issue: Walnut Creek 自述“During most of 1994 we were unable to publish any FreeBSD products because of the AT&T lawsuit. Once the lawsuit was settled, we began publishing again in January 1995”；FreeBSD 社区史称“It effectively stalled development on BSD for several years”并引 Hubbard“effectively ceded the territory to Linux during a critical period”——中断与代价可证；“数年”为定性表述（起诉至和解约一年九个月），正文宜带限定。

title: 和解后产品基线的切换
issue: McKusick 原文“all the BSD groups that were doing releases at that time, BSDI, NetBSD, and FreeBSD, had to restart their code base with the 4.4BSD-Lite sources into which they then merged their enhancements and improvements”——和解后产品以 Lite 为基线重灌获当事人一手。

title: Lite 发行的条款沿袭
issue: McKusick 原文“The newly blessed release was called 4.4BSD-Lite and was released in June 1994 under terms identical to those used for the Networking releases”——1994 年 6 月发布、条款与网络发行相同获一手原文。

title: 派生项目的基线重灌
issue: McKusick 原文即列三团体“BSDI, NetBSD, and FreeBSD, had to restart their code base with the 4.4BSD-Lite sources”——三个发行团体共同以 Lite 重起基线获当事人一手。

title: 免诉承诺的适用边界
issue: 承诺方向与题面相反：McKusick 原文“The lawsuit settlement also stipulated that USL would not sue any organization using 4.4BSD-Lite as the base for their system”——受免诉保护的是以 Lite 为基者；题面“不以 Lite 为基者不受起诉”把保护对象颠倒，须更正。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: 以 Lite 为基的免诉承诺

title: 派生产品的版本重编
issue: NetBSD 1.0 官方公告（1994-11-08）：“NetBSD 1.0 is based on 4.4BSD Lite and Berkeley Networking Release 2 sources”；NetBSD 官方谱系图示 FreeBSD 2.0 与 BSD/OS 2.0 均自 4.4BSD Lite 重基——以 Lite 为基重编版本号再发行获官方一手互证。

title: 产品名称的两度更替
issue: 名称序列获三方印证：1992–1993 年裁定书与 BSDi 促销材料均用“BSD/386”；NetBSD 官方谱系图列 BSD/386 0.3–1.1 至 BSD/OS 2.0（1995）再至 BSD/OS 5.1 ISE；FreeBSD 社区史称“It was originally called BSD/386, but later changed to BSD/OS”——两度更替（386→OS；5.x 称 ISE）可证。

title: 授权与支持的分层
issue: 授权层有价目一手（995 美元源码加二进制；McKusick 称其产品为“a commercially supported version of the code”）；支持服务另列获 BSDi 2000-03 新闻稿业务列表：“commercially supported BSD operating systems and related applications… technical support and services, open source software development, and consulting services”。

title: 发行介质的渠道整合
issue: FreeBSD 项目 2000-03-09 新闻稿：“Berkeley Software Design, Inc. (BSDI) announced today that it has merged with Walnut Creek CDROM, the distributor of the popular FreeBSD operating system. As a merged company, the new BSDI unites the leading developers and suppliers…”；FreeBSD Mall 自述同记“In March 2000, we merged with Berkeley Software Design Inc (BSDi)”——合并与新名运营获两一手。

title: 嵌入式方向的并入
issue: Wind River 2001-04-04 公告：“Wind River will be able to effectively address the needs of embedded customers who require a robust UNIX-based OS”“is a great solution for an embedded UNIX platform”“Wind River will integrate BSD technologies with the company's Tornado® development tools platform”——并入嵌入式产品线意图获收购方一手公告。

title: 与社区版的比价落差
issue: 995 美元专有系统（McKusick）对 Walnut Creek“affordable CDROMs”（自述）与 FreeBSD“low cost CD-ROM”（McKusick）——价格落差获双方一手；销量互补为定性判断，未见量化对照一手，正文不宜给具体销量数。

title: 分流时点的编年位置
issue: “数个季度内先后成形”仅合于 1993 年两支：NetBSD 官方史页记 1993 年创立（0.8 版 1993-04-20 发布），McKusick 记 FreeBSD“was formed a few months after the NetBSD group”；而 OpenBSD 分叉在“In the mid-1990s”（McKusick；通说 1995-10），与 1993 相距逾十个季度——三分支不同窗，宜改两时点表述。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: 分流的两个时点（1993 与 1995）

title: 社区项目的基线选择
issue: McKusick 记三团体“had to restart their code base with the 4.4BSD-Lite sources”；NetBSD 1.0 公告自证“based on 4.4BSD Lite”；NetBSD 官方谱系图示 FreeBSD 2.0、BSD/OS 2.0 同出 Lite——社区项目共同基线获官方一手互证。

title: 商业侧的人才流向
issue: 当事人侧转述：Wes Peters 称“In late 1991 there were 100 programmers on UseNet producing improvements for (BSD)... If not for the AT&T lawsuit at the worst moment… Because of that, people said, ‘I don't want to go with BSD now.’ That was the time Linux was gaining functionality”（Salus 访谈转录）；FreeBSD 社区史引 Hubbard“effectively ceded the territory to Linux during a critical period”——争讼期人才与补丁流向 Linux 获两源印证。

title: 收购时点的公告依据
issue: 时点宜分两层：2001-04-04 为确定性协议公告（Wind River 公告自称“expects to close this transaction by late April 2001”）；实际交割 FreeBSD Mall 自述记“In May of 2001 the software assets, including the FreeBSD Mall, were purchased from BSDi by Wind River Systems”——题面“2001 年 4 月完成收购”以公告月代交割月，宜改“2001 年 4 月公告、5 月前后交割”。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: 收购公告与交割（2001 年 4–5 月）

title: 停售与停支的年份
issue: BSD Newsletter 2003-12-13 报道（转 bsdi-users 与 Wind River 退休通知）：“sales ending on December 31, 2003”；“the standard support and maintenance for all releases of BSD/OS ISE (including bug fixes and patches…) ends on December 31, 2004”——2003 停售、2004 停支两年份与题面一致。

title: 末版发行号的位置
issue: BSD Newsletter 报道称“The final version of BSD/OS, BSD/OS 5.1 ISE, will be available as an upgrade for 5.0 ISE customers in October with sales ending on December 31, 2003”；NetBSD 官方谱系图亦以 BSD/OS 5.1 ISE 为该线末节点——5.1 末版位置获两源印证。

title: 并入嵌入式产品线
issue: Wind River 公告言明收购目的在嵌入式：“needs of embedded customers”“a great solution for an embedded UNIX platform”，并称将与 Tornado 工具平台整合——收购意图与产品定位移动获一手公告。

title: 公司更名后的去向
issue: Wind River 公告引 BSDi CEO Gary J. Johnson：“said Gary J. Johnson, CEO of BSDi, which will become iXsystems, Inc., upon closing of the sale to Wind River”；FreeBSD Mall 自述“In May of 2001… BSDi changed its name to iXsystems, and currently focuses exclusively on hardware”——出售软件业务后余部更名 iXsystems 获两一手印证。

title: 售后移交的用户反应
issue: 未获 2001 年并购后用户就续费通知询问的直接档：本会话实测仅得 2003-12 停售期 bsdi-users 用户表态（BSD Newsletter 转述“I hope that only WR Japan is going to discontinue BSD/OS ISE, not entire WR”“Our FreeBSD migration is almost complete”等）；comp.unix.bsd.bsdi.announce 与 bsdi-users 2001 年档未能本会话实测取回（无可用公开档面），判存疑待邮件档补证。

title: 端点抽象的定义文本
issue: FreeBSD socket(2)：“The socket() system call creates an endpoint for communication and returns a descriptor.”；NetBSD socket(2) 同文（“socket() creates an endpoint for communication and returns a descriptor.”）——端点定义文本两系一致获一手。

title: 通信语义的类型划分
issue: NetBSD socket(2)：“SOCK_STREAM Provides sequenced, reliable, two-way connection based byte streams. An out-of-band data transmission mechanism may be supported.”——题面“有序、可靠、双向连接与带外数据”与手册原文逐点对应。

title: 地址格式的完整枚举
issue: 手册页枚举地址族：NetBSD socket(2) 列 PF_LOCAL（local domain, previously UNIX domain）、PF_INET（ARPA Internet）、PF_INET6、PF_NS（Xerox Network Systems）等；AIX 7.3 手册记“AF_UNIX Denotes the operating system path names. AF_INET Denotes the ARPA Internet addresses”——UNIX 路径名与互联网地址同列一接口获两系一手。

title: 协议域的选取规则
issue: 两系手册同文：“Normally only a single protocol exists to support a particular socket type within a given protocol family”（FreeBSD/NetBSD socket(2)），且“The protocol number to use is particular to the ‘communication domain’ in which communication is to take place”——选取规则由通信域而非进程指定获手册原文。

title: 带外数据的语义错配
issue: RFC 6093（IETF，2011-01）：“The TCP urgent mechanism is NOT a mechanism for sending ‘out-of-band’ data: the so-called ‘urgent data’ should be delivered ‘in-line’ to the TCP user”，并称实现默认处理为“the (broken) default processing of urgent indications”——协议仅有紧急数据而接口提供带外语义的错配获标准文件一手。

title: 原始套接字的权限限制
issue: NetBSD socket(2)：“SOCK_RAW Provides access to internal network protocols and interfaces. Available only to the super-user.”；AIX 手册同义（“This type of socket is available only to the root user”）——权限限制写入手册页获两系一手。

title: 互联网地址族的接入
issue: NetBSD socket(2) 地址族条目作“PF_INET ARPA Internet protocols”；AIX 手册作“AF_INET Denotes the ARPA Internet addresses”——ARPA 互联网地址条目获两系手册原文。

title: 传输层协议的并置
issue: NetBSD inet(4)：“TCP is used to support the SOCK_STREAM abstraction while UDP is used to support the SOCK_DGRAM abstraction. A raw interface to IP is available by creating an Internet socket of type SOCK_RAW.”——两类传输在同一接口层并置获手册原文。

title: 多协议并存的重构
issue: McKusick：“it became clear to Joy and Leffler that the new system would need to provide support for more than just the DARPA standard network protocols. Thus, they redesigned the internal structuring of the software, refining the interfaces so that multiple network protocols could be used simultaneously.”——多协议并存的重构为编程模型成形前提获当事人一手。

title: 原型代码的整合时序
issue: McKusick：“When Rob Gurwitz released an early implementation of the TCP/IP protocols to Berkeley, Joy integrated it into the system and tuned its performance”（Gurwitz 属 DARPA 承包方 BBN）；《4.4BSD 设计与实现》官档：“a 4.1BSD-based implementation was publicly available from a DARPA-sponsored project at Bolt, Beranek, and Newman (BBN)”——承包方交付、核心开发者整合调优获两手互证。

title: 设计目标的条目化
issue: McKusick 记 4.2BSD 目标逐条列出：“provide flexible interprocess communication facilities that allow researchers to do work in distributed systems, and would integrate networking support so that machines running the new system could easily participate in the ARPAnet”——IPC 与网络支持同列设计目标、条目化可核获当事人一手。

title: 首个 TCP/IP 实现的归属
issue: “Unix 上首个 TCP/IP 实现”与官档相悖：《4.4BSD 设计与实现》明言 4.2BSD 选 TCP/IP 乃因“a 4.1BSD-based implementation was publicly available from a DARPA-sponsored project at Bolt, Beranek, and Newman (BBN)”——BBN 的 Unix TCP/IP 早于 4.2BSD；二手“first implementation of TCP/IP”（Winsock FAQ）系简化。可证者为：4.2BSD 的首个协议套件即 TCP/IP，且“The 4.2BSD implementation is the main reason for the extremely widespread use of this protocol suite”，并被各方采用回灌 System V（McKusick）。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: 4.2BSD 的 TCP/IP 归宿与多方采用

title: 手册页的跨系统复制
issue: 商用系统手册留有同文副本：IBM AIX 7.3 socket 子例程页首句“Creates an end point for communication and returns a descriptor”，与 FreeBSD/NetBSD socket(2) 定义句逐字几同；AIX 页并自注 COMPAT_43“will make the sockaddr structure BSD 4.3 compatible”——接口扩散的文件级证据获厂商一手。

title: 厂商采用的时间窗口
issue: McKusick：“The popularity of 4.2BSD was impressive; within eighteen months more than 1,000 site licenses had been issued.”——十八个月内千余份站点许可获当事人一手原文。

title: 示例文档的流传方式
issue: IPC 入门文档随发行树流通：NetBSD socket(2) 与 inet(4) 参考文献均列 Sechrest 教程并注路径“/usr/share/doc/reference/ref3/sockets”；FreeBSD socket(2) 列 PS1:7；Winsock 1.1 规范正文自述素材“The following material is derived from the document ‘An Advanced 4.3BSD Interprocess Communication Tutorial’ by Samuel J. Leffler, Robert S. Fabry, William N. Joy, Phil Lapsley, Steve Miller, and Chris Torek”——教学载体跨系流传获三面一手。

title: 编程模型的来源声明
issue: Winsock 1.1 规范（1993-01-20）正文：“The Windows Sockets Specification has been built upon the Berkeley Sockets programming model which is the de facto standard for TCP/IP networking… The Windows Sockets API is consistent with release 4.3 of the Berkeley Software Distribution (4.3BSD)”，且来源声明写在规范正文（产品文档）而非致谢页。

title: 1.1 规范的兼容承诺
issue: Microsoft 官方文档（Windows CE 5.0 存档）：“Winsock 2.2 maintains full backward compatibility with Winsock 1.1 on two levels: source and binary”；同司 TechNet 存档记“Version 1.1 of the specification was released in January 1993, and version 2.2.0 was published in May of 1996”——向后兼容承诺与时点获官方一手。

title: 系统内置的分发时点
issue: “Windows 95 为首个开箱即带该接口的系统版本”不确：Winsock FAQ 记“Microsoft's first OS release including a Winsock-based stack was Windows NT 3.1, which came out in mid-1993, a year after the first Winsock spec”——NT 3.1（1993）已内置 Winsock 栈，Windows 95（1995-08）仅为 DOS 系消费线首个；题面宜限定“消费线”或改系 NT 3.1。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕〔D3 适配后定题：内置 TCP/IP 的分发时点（NT 3.1 先行）；消费线腿留论题〕
suggested_title: 内置分发的时点（NT 3.1 先行，Windows 95 及于消费线）

title: NT 上的子系统移植
issue: 子系统移植载体可证：Reiter 记“around 1996, Softway Systems developed a UNIX-to-Windows NT porting system called OpenNT. OpenNT was built on the NT POSIX subsystem but fleshed it out into a usable UNIX environment… Softway used OpenNT to re-target a number of UNIX applications for US Federal agencies onto Windows NT”，1999 年微软收购；Interix 侧 sockets 接口实现见其“broke some previously stable APIs like select()”等载述——“该接口经 NT 子系统落地”成立；“System V 进程间通信”一项未获逐字一手，建议正文补证或放宽为“UNIX 编程环境”。

title: API 限缩的模拟方案
issue: 已查 Winsock 1.1 规范全文、MS Learn 移植指南（Porting Socket Applications to Winsock：偏离 Berkeley 惯例仅少数并逐一注明）、Winsock 2.2 兼容文档与 OpenNT/Interix 材料，均未见与“模拟方案把新规范限缩回套接字接口”直接对应的表述；候选所指（1.1 对 BSD 接口的收敛子集、2.2 对 1.1 的源码/二进制兼容、Berkeley 应用移植收敛于 Winsock）各述一面——所指不明，判存疑待起草方澄清。

title: 早期栈的第三方转述
issue: 第三方供给获当事人侧一手：前 Spider Systems 成员 Mark Valentine 确认 NT 3.1 早期栈来自 Spider Systems（SpiderTCP，STREAMS 实现，NT 至 4.0 带 STREAMS），并明言“The core SpiderTCP protocol implementation is _not_ derived from BSD. Some of the utilities which were added as the product was developed came from Net/1 or Net/2 (hence the FTP.EXE copyright string)”——第三方以独立子系统提供成立；BSD 源流之说不确（核心非 BSD 派生、工具链自 Net/1/Net/2），正文宜分记。

title: 解析器库的接口约定
issue: ISC 官方 BIND 9 页：“As the first, oldest, and most commonly deployed solution, there are more network engineers who are already familiar with BIND 9 than with any other system.”——首个且部署最广获实现方官方自述。

title: DNS 规范的文本依据
issue: RFC 1034（P. Mockapetris，ISI，1987-11）“DOMAIN NAMES - CONCEPTS AND FACILITIES”为独立发布的规范文本（伴生 RFC 1035 为实现与规范）——接口语义以文本而非某实现为准获标准文本一手。

title: 开源许可的条款选择
issue: ISC 许可页：BIND 9 于 9.11.0b 之前各版走宽松 ISC 许可（“Permission to use, copy, modify, and/or distribute this software for any purpose with or without fee is hereby granted…”），更早系（4.3BSD 时代解析器谱系）同类宽松条款；现行 BIND 9 已转 MPL 2.0——“宽松开源许可”须限定在 9.11 之前与解析器遗产口径，正文宜加时点限定。

title: 解析库的移除始末
issue: FreeBSD 10.0-RELEASE 公告（2014-01-20）：“Unbound has been imported to the base system as the local caching DNS resolver. BIND has been removed from the base system.”——移出并另立替代获官方公告一手；注意移除对象为 BIND 套件（服务器与工具），libc 内解析器例程未动，题面“解析库”宜作“DNS 套件/解析器”表述。

title: 配置文件的发行路径
issue: sendmail 配置源随发行树入系统源码目录：FreeBSD src 树内 contrib/sendmail/cf/README 即配置文件说明（“SENDMAIL CONFIGURATION FILES… This document describes the sendmail configuration files. It explains how to create a sendmail.cf file for use with sendmail.”），并记 MAIL_SETTINGS_DIR 缺省“/etc/mail/”——路径固定、可复制公共资产获一手文本。

title: 配置工具的封装层次
issue: cf/README：“Configuration files are contained in the subdirectory ‘cf’, with a suffix ‘.mc’. They must be run through ‘m4’ to produce a ‘.cf’ file… you can simply: cd ${CFDIR}/cf; ./Build config.cf”，另记“Sendmail uses the M4 macro processor to ‘compile’ the configuration files”——配置生成封装为独立工具获一手原文。

title: 抓包库的平台支持面
issue: libpcap 自述“a system-independent interface for user-level packet capture. libpcap provides a portable framework for low-level network monitoring”，README 载支持面“BPF is standard in NetBSD, FreeBSD, OpenBSD, DragonFly BSD, macOS, QNX and Solaris 11; an older, modified and undocumented version is standard in AIX.”——开源与商用系统横跨的支持清单获官方一手。

title: BPF 与抓包工具的分工
issue: BPF 论文（McCanne & Jacobson，1993-01 USENIX）：“BPF has two main components: the network tap and the packet filter. The network tap collects copies of packets from the network device drivers and delivers them to listening applications.”（内核侧）；应用侧“The most widely used is tcpdump, a network monitoring and data acquisition tool. Tcpdump performs three primary tasks: filter translation, packet acquisition, and packet display.”——内核接口与用户命令分工获论文一手。

title: 发行版本的维护周期
issue: 已查 BPF 论文全文（仅称“BPF is now about two years old”，1992-12 档）、tcpdump 最早手册条目（1989-06，论文参考文献）与 libpcap README（仅记“maintaining binary compatibility between libpcap releases for quite a while”），均未见“一轮发行积累近六年开发”的量化记载；“近六年”所指无一手对应，判存疑待补证。

title: 双绑定标准化的结果
issue: Open Group 官方页（XNS Issue 5.2，2000-01-15 出版，Adopted）：“These comprise the Sockets Interface and the X/Open Transport Interface (XTI). The Sockets Interface (part 2 of this document) is now the main industry-standard interface. XTI (part 3 of this document) is now considered to be obsolete…”——两套候选接口同册标准化、两存而非择一获标准组织一手；poll/select 双轨在吸收 XNS 5.2 口径的 SUSv3 中并存（poll() 见 XSH，multiplexing 原文已实测取回；select 同册另列）。

title: 头文件的标准归属
issue: SUSv3 <sys/socket.h> 页：“The header shall define… the sockaddr structure that includes at least the following members: sa_family_t sa_family; char sa_data[]”，并列 SOCK_STREAM/SOCK_DGRAM/SOCK_RAW/SOCK_SEQPACKET 与 AF_INET/AF_INET6/AF_UNIX——地址结构与类型由标准头文件定义、归属由标准文本决定获标准一手。

title: 迁移层的接口兼容
issue: OpenNT/Interix 即迁移层实例：Reiter 记其为“UNIX-to-Windows NT porting system”，“used OpenNT to re-target a number of UNIX applications for US Federal agencies onto Windows NT”，1999 年并入微软 SFU——以该接口承接 UNIX 应用移植、兼容层为事实标准落地形态获二手详引。

title: 事实标准的确认方式
issue: 文本固化路径完整：标准头文件逐条定义（SUSv3 <sys/socket.h> 列 sockaddr、SOCK_*、AF_* 等）；派生实现手册自认符合标准——FreeBSD/NetBSD socket(2) STANDARDS 节“The socket() call/function conforms to IEEE Std 1003.1-2001/2008 (‘POSIX.1’)”——确认方式由文本固化获标准文本与两系手册互证。

title: 派生实现的条目一致
issue: 本会话并取 FreeBSD 15.1 与 NetBSD 11.99 socket(2) 全文比对：NAME（“create an endpoint for communication”）、定义句、SOCK_STREAM/SOCK_DGRAM/SOCK_RAW 语义条目、“Normally only a single protocol exists…”与 HISTORY“The socket() … appeared in 4.2BSD”逐条一致（措辞微异）——同名手册页条目一致支撑事实标准判断获实测并读。

title: 商业 UNIX 前夜的许可格局
issue: Salus（BYTE 1994-10，经 exa 取 Wayback 档）：“AT&T's ``house rules'' for Unix included no support, no bug fixes, and no credit.”＋“``no advertising, no support, no bug fixes, payment in advance''”＋“AT&T believed, because of the consent decree, that it was constrained to stay out of the computer business.”——四不条款与同意令背景逐字命中

title: 厂商转向 4.2BSD 的技术动因
issue: McKusick：“Most of the Unix vendors shipped a 4.2BSD system rather than the commercial System V from AT&T. The reason was that System V had neither networking nor the Berkley Fast filesystem.”（原文 Berkley 系拼误照录）——动因逐字命中

title: 网络代码的独立授权需求
issue: McKusick：“vendors that wanted to build standalone TCP/IP-based networking products for the PC market using the BSD code found the per-binary costs prohibitive. So, they requested that Berkeley break out the networking code and utilities and provide them under licensing terms that did not require an AT&T source license.”——拆分需求逐字命中

title: 学术发行到产业供给的接续
issue: Salus：“The fact that the BSD release had a simple license agreement, credited those who produced the software, and was priced at the actual cost of the media and distribution”——成本价发行逐字命中

title: 首例商业 UNIX 服务的出现
issue: Salus：“in 1977, Interactive Systems (Santa Monica, CA) became the first company to support Unix commercially. It was soon followed by Human Computing Resources in Toronto.”——1977 首例与多伦多同业逐字命中

title: 创立公告与业务范围
issue: Salus：“in 1977, Interactive Systems…became the first company to support Unix commercially”——1977 年创立成立；⚠️“USENIX 会议上宣告成立”与“四项服务”细分未逐字（原文止于支持服务），建议论题收缩或补 Interactive 自述

title: 客户名单的行业构成
issue: “至 1980 年初客户已含贝尔实验室、多所大学与航空航天、通信机构”的客户名单未获一手（已查 Salus 文与 McKusick 章）——建议补 Interactive 自述或年表源

title: 改进意见的征集渠道
issue: “借 1977 年 8 月 USENIX 会议记录公开征集 UNIX 改进建议”未见一手（Salus 文仅载用户组集会与新闻报告）——建议补会议记录原件或改题

title: 系统迁移的技术基线
issue: “1982 年把产品从 V6／PWB 体系迁往 System III”未获一手（Salus 文与 McKusick 章均无此句）——建议补 Interactive 产品年表〔C4 官方形修订补记（论题层）2026-11-03：官方名论题随 §4.4 形态附表半角化〕

title: 首个商业支持者的时序
issue: Salus：“It was soon followed by Human Computing Resources in Toronto.”——先于多伦多同业逐字命中

title: 源码递送的载体形态
issue: Salus：“The license was on one side of a sheet of paper.”＋磁带载体（“a standard `tp' format, 800-bpi magnetic tape”）——一页纸许可与磁带载体逐字命中

title: 人员流动的技术携带
issue: McKusick：“In the late spring of 1982, Joy announced he was joining Sun Microsystems.”＋Salus：“Bill Joy left Berkeley shortly before 4.2BSD came out. He took the then-current system, 4.1c, with him to Sun Microsystems.”——转职与携行两半均逐字命中

title: 接口约定的复制方式
issue: TUHS 4.2BSD socket(2)（.TH SOCKET 2 “18 July 1983”）：“Socket creates an endpoint for communication and returns a descriptor.”——调用签名与描述符的接口形态逐字命中；⚠️“不依赖实现细节即可在另一系统重建”系推广语，建议论题改“以套接口签名为界的接口约定”

title: 发行体系的接续关系
issue: McKusick：“The original intent had been to call it the 5BSD release; however, there were objections from AT&T that there would be customer confusion…So, to resolve the issue, Berkeley agreed to change the naming scheme for future releases to stay at 4BSD and just increment the minor number.”——编号接续逐字命中

title: 发行文档的署名要求
issue: McKusick（Net1 条款）：“The only requirements were that the copyright notices in the source file be left intact and that products that incorporated the code indicate in their documentation that the product contained code from the University of California and its contributors.”——署名要求逐字命中；⚠️题面泛化到全部伯克利代码产品，注记口径为 Net1 条款

title: 合流方向的技术原因
issue: McKusick《伯克利 UNIX 二十年》（Open Sources 网络版，实取全文）原文：“Most of the Unix vendors shipped a 4.2BSD system rather than the commercial System V from AT&T. The reason was that System V had neither networking nor the Berkley Fast filesystem.”——System V 缺网络与快速文件系统两项、厂商先取 4.2BSD，均获当事人一手支撑（“Berkley”系原文拼写）。

title: 后续回流的选择过程
issue: 同章两段互证：其一“As networking and other 4.2BSD improvements were integrated into the system V release, the vendors usually switched back to it.”（System V 补齐网络后厂商多回迁）；其二“Although most of the vendors had started the switch back to System V, large parts of 4.3BSD were carried over into their systems, particularly the networking subsystem.”（网络子系统仍沿用伯克利实现）——选择性回流成立。

title: 早期商业版本的基线
issue: 同章原文：“Most of the Unix vendors shipped a 4.2BSD system rather than the commercial System V from AT&T.”，并载 4.1c 一节“many vendors used this release to prepare for ports of 4.2 to their hardware.”——早期商业系统以 4.2 为基线确证；“两类最为显著”之分类系题面自设，一手未作两类之分。

title: 贝尔实验室发行的终止
issue: 同章原文逐点吻合：“The final release from Bell Laboratories was 32/V; thereafter all Unix releases from AT&T, initially System III and later System V, were managed by a different group that emphasized stable commercial releases.”——32/V 为贝尔实验室最后发行、此后商业发行由另一团体管理并强调稳定，皆直接可引。

title: 版本编号的避讳调整
issue: 同章原文：“The original intent had been to call it the 5BSD release; however, there were objections from AT&T that there would be customer confusion between their commercial Unix release, System V, and a Berkeley release named 5BSD. So, to resolve the issue, Berkeley agreed to change the naming scheme for future releases to stay at 4BSD and just increment the minor number.”——避讳改号全过程可引。

title: 网络子系统的移植面
issue: 同章原文：“Although most of the vendors had started the switch back to System V, large parts of 4.3BSD were carried over into their systems, particularly the networking subsystem.”——回迁系统保留伯克利网络子系统、移植面集中于网络层获当事人支撑。

title: 手册页的同源证据
issue: 同源证据落在文件：AIX 7.3 socket 子例程官方文档 Purpose 栏“Creates an end point for communication and returns a descriptor.”与 NetBSD socket(2)“socket() creates an endpoint for communication and returns a descriptor.”文本近同；AIX 文档并自载“The socket applications can be compiled with COMPAT_43 defined. This will make the sockaddr structure BSD 4.3 compatible.”——商业系统手册页与伯克利树同源，有文件可对。

title: 计费方式的技术阻力
issue: 同章原文：“With the increasing cost of the AT&T source licenses, vendors that wanted to build standalone TCP/IP-based networking products for the PC market using the BSD code found the per-binary costs prohibitive.”——阻力来自计费而非技术确证；细读系“源许可费用上涨”与“按二进制计（per-binary）”两项并存，题面压缩为“源码许可按二进制计费”欠精，宜于论题层分写。

title: 复制行为的当事人记述
issue: “首个被广泛复制实现”之当事人记述未获：已实取 McKusick《伯克利 UNIX 二十年》全文（无此语）；已实取 4.4BSD 设计手册网络实现节，仅“The 4.2BSD implementation is the main reason for the extremely widespread use of this protocol suite.”（言协议套件广泛使用之因，非接口复制，亦无“首个”）；两轮网检未见“first widely copied”当事人原文。“被广泛复制”侧有旁证（Winsock 规范自述基于 Berkeley sockets，回指 V56.4 已证），但“首个”＋当事人记述未获一手，判存疑。

title: 网络产品的独立授权
issue: 同章原文：“The BSD originated networking code and supporting utilities were released in June 1989 as Networking Release 1, the first freely-redistributable code from Berkeley.”，并明言征集动机在提供“licensing terms that did not require an AT&T source license”——1989 年网络代码与工具独立授权、商业系统由此获得无须源许可之合规来源，皆可引。

title: 工具集的重写工程
issue: 同章原文：“He solicited folks to rewrite the Unix utilities from scratch based solely on their published descriptions.”（Bostic 征集依公开描述从零重写）——“按公开描述逐件重写”直接可引；“版权问题转为工程问题”属解读层。

title: 贡献者署名的激励
issue: 同章原文：“Their only compensation would be to have their name listed among the Berkeley contributors next to the name of the utility that they rewrote.”——唯一报酬为署名，直接可引。

title: 重写完成的时间跨度
issue: 同章原文：“Soon the list crossed one hundred utilities and within 18 months nearly all the important utilities and libraries had been rewritten.”——十八个月内覆盖主要工具与库，直接可引。

title: 命令体系的兼容取舍
issue: 同章末段原文：“about half of the utilities that it comes packaged with are drawn from the BSD distribution”——“另一系统”（本章隐名语体下指 Linux）工具约半数取自该发行，直接可引。

title: 屏幕管理的解释器
issue: 同章原文逐点吻合：“he decided to consolidate the screen management by using a small interpreter to redraw the screen. This interpreter was driven by a description of the terminal characteristics, an effort that eventually became termcap.”——小型解释器、由终端特性描述驱动、终端差异移出程序，皆可引。

title: curses 的游戏渊源
issue: 游戏需求促成说与当事人相悖：Arnold 自述（Craddock《Dungeon Hacks》改编文，实取）“People often believe that curses was written for Rogue because most people saw them at the same time.”，成因另述为“Tired of revising code every time a new terminal appeared in the lab, Arnold wrote a platform-agnostic library of cursor functions”（为免逐终端重写，与 Rogue 无涉）；二手讹传例见 Raymond 1995（实取）“The first curses library was hacked together at the University of California at Berkeley in about 1980 to support a screen-oriented dungeon game called rogue.”——Rogue 系采用者而非促成者，建议改题。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: Rogue 采用 curses 的次序

title: vi 编辑器的派生序列
issue: 同章原文两段恰成序列：“Working from an editor named em that they had obtained from Professor George Coulouris at Queen Mary’s College in London, they worked to produce the line-at-a-time editor ex.”与“With the arrival of some ADM-3a terminals offering screen-addressable cursors, Joy was finally able to write vi”——行编辑器先成 ex、可寻址光标到位后方成 vi，直接可引。

title: 跨系统移植的时点
issue: V8 时点获当事人邮件直证（TUHS 邮件档，实取）：McIlroy“Curses appears in the v8 manual but not v7.”；《Life with UNIX》转录（同页）：“In particular, the C shell, curses, termcap, vi and … were ported back to Version 7 (and later System III) so that it was not unusual to find these features on otherwise pure Bell releases.”——伯克利成分入贝尔发行之方向确证；细读移植先于 V8 手册著录（V7／System III 层面），题面系于第八版宜以“V8 手册始著录”为口径。

title: 复刻实现的当代存续
issue: 复刻自述近于完整复刻：Bostic 官方页（实取）“Nvi supports all the historic ex/vi features except for open mode and the lisp edit option (e.g., it has a fully implemented underlying ex mode).”；nvi(1) 手册（实取）“Nex/nvi are intended as bug-for-bug compatible replacements for the original Fourth Berkeley Software Distribution (4BSD) ex and vi programs.”——接口寿命长于实现之断言可立。

title: 声明互置的争议结构
issue: 同章原文：“The University’s suit claimed that USL had failed in their obligation to provide due credit to the University for the use of BSD code in System V as required by the license that they had signed with the University.”——校方反诉指未按许可致谢，争点在声明义务互置而非代码归属，直接可引。

title: 版权头的层叠形态
issue: 文件级实证：FreeBSD tcp_subr.c 版权头（实取）“Copyright (c) 1982, 1986, 1988, 1990, 1993, 1995 / The Regents of the University of California.”多年份堆叠；OpenBSD 版权政策页（实取）引例“Copyright (c) 1982, 1986, 1990, 1991, 1993 The Regents…”同形——层叠形态记录不同年份之并入。

title: 广告致谢条款的存废
issue: 存废两端各有正式文本：OpenBSD 版权政策页（实取）全文引四条伯克利许可，第 3 条“All advertising materials mentioning features or use of this software must display the following acknowledgement: This product includes software developed by the University of California, Berkeley and its contributors.”，并载“Berkeley rescinded the 3rd term (the advertising term) on 22 July 1999.”——先立后废皆有所据。

title: 同源文件的比对方法
issue: 体例题：以同名文件跨发行树逐件比对为方法承诺，无外部事实断言；与本章 5.5.1–5.5.3 之文件级实证面自洽，目录核查通过。

title: 痕迹判定的证据强度
